item.title: GovBrief Today #567
item.description: ICE's own emails now confirm it let Iran's government edit America's deportation lists. "Per request from the Iran Embassy [sic] I added a few cases," one official wrote before the first of three flights that returned more than 100 Iranians. Detainees had sworn in court that Iranian officials somehow knew the details of their asylum claims. The emails released this week describe face-to-face meetings with Tehran's diplomats and removals expedited because Iran asked. It all happened between June 2025's attack on Iran and the war that began in February. Days after Trump told Iranians to evacuate Tehran, the White House ordered their removals fast-tracked, and ICE spent the buildup to the next round of bombing taking the regime's edits on who got sent back. When those detainees first described the cooperation in court last month, ICE called it hearsay. I've emailed 8,737 stories over 567 straight nights, free and without ads. The algorithm can't show them all to you. Add your email address at govbrief.today and I will.
